body:
Thanks for picking up #114, @Niranjan-cyber! This looks good overall: keeping private-index packages on their locked files and recording the source index for `poetry.lock` is the right shape, and the tests cover both lockfile formats.

This one touches `src/wheelgap/pypi.py` and is for a `help wanted` issue, so Patrick will review and merge it himself. A few things he'll likely look at:

- `fill_all` now skips non-PyPI packages even without `--online`, so a private-index package with no locked files would no longer be looked up at all.
- `is_pypi` accepts a few more PyPI spellings than `recheck_lock()` did before.
- The CHANGELOG entry sits under a `### Fixed` heading and needs the credit suffix (`(#133, thanks [@Niranjan-cyber](https://github.com/Niranjan-cyber))`).

_(Review assisted by Claude.)_
<!-- wheelgap-bot reviewed fa98acf6591b78b2377a30a5e9366eb9c3d24885 -->

Thanks for the quick follow-up, @Niranjan-cyber! The new commit addresses the earlier notes nicely: the private-index filter now only applies with `--online`, `is_pypi` matches the old `recheck_lock()` rule, both are pinned by tests, and the CHANGELOG bullet has the credit suffix.

One small thing left for Patrick to tidy: the bullet still sits under a `### Fixed` heading, and `## Unreleased` is kept as one flat list.

As before, this touches `src/wheelgap/pypi.py` and is for a `help wanted` issue, so Patrick will review and merge it himself (CI hasn't run on this commit yet either).

_(Review assisted by Claude.)_
<!-- wheelgap-bot reviewed d2ac83ffb8656344f4cd9deb82952e2b109f92c1 -->

Merged, thanks @Niranjan-cyber, and welcome! Keeping private-index packages on their locked files is exactly the fix #114 needed, and recording `[package.source]` for `poetry.lock` closes the second half of it. Your follow-up commit had already sorted out the `fill_all` and `is_pypi` points from the first review.

Before merging we:
- kept the `requires-python` warning working under `--online`. A private package locked for a narrower Python can still be missing wheels, so that note now prints for it, even with `-q`;
- moved the tests into `test_cli.py`, `test_sources.py` and `test_pypi.py`, added a `pylock.toml` case and a `-q` test, and an assertion on the note's text;
- updated the README's `--online` paragraph and tidied the CHANGELOG entry.

If you'd like another one in the same area, #56 is the Pipfile.lock version of this bug. `Pipfile.lock` records each package's `index`, and mapping it to `registry` through `_meta.sources` builds directly on what you just did.

_(Review assisted by Claude.)_
<!-- wheelgap-bot reviewed fdb892a93fbc26a9706e483d0ef78bef024d01cd -->
